routing_warnings.description: This message requests replacing the hero image with a supplied video rather than changing the surrounding hero layout.
In context, the generic revision claim refers to the requested hero-video replacement; the same message separately addresses timeline image alignment.
The observed playback failure concerns the playable hero-video Requirement, not the hero block layout.
The pricing-panel overflow clause reports a separate mobile viewport failure for the pricing panels.
This message concerns pricing panels extending outside the mobile frame, not YouTube icon visibility.
The message also reports that the YouTube button is hidden behind a mobile dropdown; that clause belongs to the mobile YouTube visibility Requirement.
The freelancer's implementation claim concerns mobile YouTube icon visibility, not pricing-panel frame fit.
